findings: The 222 by 90 mm base contains one Nucleo outline envelope and one populated CAN carrier; the render is complete in both views.
The Nucleo is an unpopulated outline reference. These images do not establish fit for its connectors or components.
The carrier has four aligned support bosses, two end connector housings and one termination header; the small surface-mounted parts remain on the carrier.
The two cable-tie slots remain open alongside the carrier. Physical assembly and retention strength remain untested.

checks.finding: One base, one Nucleo outline and one populated CAN carrier are visible.
The Nucleo outline occupies the left cradle; the smaller 60 by 40 mm carrier occupies the right boss pattern.
Both carrier connector housings, the termination header, support bosses and two tie slots are visible.
No isolated part is visible outside the two board locations and the mounting base.
The carrier mounting holes sit on four bosses; the Nucleo outline sits between the cradle rails and corner stops.
Both board planes face upward and the carrier connector access stays above the base.
The full isometric and top views show the same board locations, support pattern and open tie slots without cropping.
